summary: 16x16 pixel drawing pad with mirror mode for symmetric strokes; cells pop as you paint and Clear drops every pixel with gravity.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires at the end of each pointer stroke and after each cell painted or erased with Space or Enter.

events.name: clear
events.description: Fires when the pad is cleared.

methods.description: Drops every painted cell off the bottom of the pad (with reduced motion, removes them at once) and fires `clear`.

keyboard.action: Paint the cell under the cursor, or erase it if it already has the current colour.

accessibility: The canvas is focusable with `role="img"` and `aria-label="16 by 16 pixel drawing pad"`; the drawing itself is not described. A visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region reports the cursor cell and its colour after each arrow key, Space or Enter, for example "Row 9, column 9, empty".
The colour swatches sit in a `role="group"` labelled "Colour"; each is a button with an `aria-label` (Ink, Accent, Success, Warning, Danger) and `aria-pressed`.
Mirror is a toggle button with `aria-pressed`; Clear is a native button.
motion: With reduced motion painted cells appear without popping and Clear empties the pad at once instead of dropping the cells.
notes: The pad starts with a sample robot drawing. Mirror mode is on by default and reflects strokes across the vertical centre.
Starting a stroke on a cell of the current colour erases instead of painting.
Colours follow the theme tokens. There is no API to read or export the drawing. The pad is a fixed 224 by 224px.
